summary: Meta researchers present Brain2Qwerty v2, a model decoding natural sentences from non-invasive MEG brain recordings using deep learning and finetuned LLM representations, achieving 39% word error rate.

practices.reason: The paper describes using AI agents to iteratively refine a decoding pipeline via automated code development, a technique but under-specified and domain-specific.
practices.quote: the deployment of AI agents to iteratively refine our decoding pipeline via automated code development
